title: Azura Adventure
description: Survival-friendly modpack that spices up the game with fun and co-operative features while staying true to the vanilla immersion.
body:
![Project branding](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd0e42dc78a7babb3a6063dc44699d2172a7765a.png)

Azura Adventure is a fine-tuned modpack aiming to enhance the vanilla experience with intriguing content designed to sustain long-term player interest on SMPs. The most prominent additions include new biomes, structures, mobs, and loot in all of the vanilla dimensions, making exploration more rewarding and interesting. The main objective is not to make the modpack too heavy, but instead to keep the Minecraft spirit.

During the development of this modpack, it has received feedback and improvements from real SMP usage, making this a trustworthy pick for your future adventures. Azura Adventure has been built in a way that encourages a co-operative playstyle with friends, which always creates the best experience and memories.

‎ 
## <center>What does this modpack offer</center>
- **🎙️ Voice Chat** — Enables proximity/extended/global communication.
- **🌍 Terrain generation** — The recipe for new adventures and ideas.
- **🏰 Structures of varying sizes** — The hotspots of exciting events.
- **📊 Revamped progression** — Single-handedly make the SMP last longer with End Remastered.
- **🎁 New items** — The world is full of new loot, enchantments, and abilities yet to be found.
- **🏅 More achievements** — You'll always have something new to aim for.
- **❄️ Realistic temperature** — Fight against the cold and heat with appropriate gear.
- **🍁 Experience seasons** — Leaves change color, snow accumulates and melts, and temperature changes.
- **👺 Improved bosses** — The Ender Dragon, Wither, and Warden are not as boring.
- **💀 Revive system** — Rescue your friends in time to save them, making adventures last longer.
- **🪙 Rebrand emeralds** — Balance the villager trading economy with a new scalable currency.
- **✨ Visual upgrades** — Take immersion to the next level with versatile effects.
- **🔊 Audial upgrades** — Improve the hearing experience with ambience and sound physics.
- **🛠️ QoL Features** — Optimizations, shaders, dynamic lights, zoom, and optional distant chunk rendering.

‎ 

I won't spoil everything; these are just the highlights. There's more to explore, and all it takes is to spin up a world. To mention a few bits you'll encounter, you now have the ability to sit and crawl anywhere, view the playtime so you can remind yourself of all the things you've spent time on, perform daps and all sorts of [fun](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jO511a19XeE) stuff with your friends, and encounter dangerous zombie hordes every few nights...

## 
<details>
<summary>📖 Information for players</summary>

### Common keybinds
- Third-person F5 has been remapped to **R** for ease of access.
- The World Map opens from the **Right Shift** (located below Enter)
- The shaderpack selection screen will open with P
- Toggle your active shader by pressing O
- The performance overlay toggles with Y
- Open the emote wheel with B
- The zoom keybind is C

### Voice Chat instructions
- Press **V** (while inside a world) to open the Voice Chat settings. Here you can modify the **Microphone** settings, if needed. You may also raise the **Activation Threshold** to -40 or -30 if your microphone easily picks up background noise.
- Your default proximity distance is **96 blocks** (6 chunks), which is the maximum distance at which your voice can be heard when you talk normally. However, the distance greatly depends on the number of blocks blocking the line of sight.
- When you hold down your **middle mouse button**, the maximum voice range will extend to **200 blocks** (12.5 chunks). In real-world situations, this will only make your voice louder (not clearer) when there's distance and blocks in the way.
- By holding down the **<** button, your voice will be clearly heard by the entire server.

### Some player abilities
- If you and your friend hold X while running towards each other and release it at the same time as you collide, you will perform a dap. (Both of you must have an empty hand and offhand.)
- To catch a player who's falling, press § (the key left to 1) right before the landing.
- Sit down anywhere by looking down and sneaking two times, executing **/sit**, or pressing Right CTRL.
- Press ALTGR or execute **/crawl** to enter crawl mode.
- You can watch a [video tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ePsdkld3CsE) on some abilities I didn't document here. Note that this modpack has changed some keybinds that show up in the video for conflict reasons.


</details>


<details>
<summary>🔧 Notes for server admins</summary>

- The modpack will function under a dedicated server environment with one modification, that is to remove [Mod Loading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/mod-loading-screen) from the server side, since it's incompatible.
- By default, players do not have permission to use the [priority](https://modrinth.com/plugin/pv-addon-priority) or [broadcast](https://modrinth.com/plugin/pv-addon-broadcast) features of Plasmo Voice. You need to manually grant them the respective permissions or import the template permission file I bundled with the modpack. You can execute `/lp import azura-v1.json.gz --replace` from the console to get everything working.
- If you applied the previous LuckPerms template, all players can now toggle the real-time MSPT bossbbar by pressing F6. Previously, this was restricted to operators.
- Non-operators will see a drastically reduced list of tab-completion commands to remove chat clutter. You can tweak this client-side blacklist found at `/config/commandremover.txt`. These commands would be hidden from operators as well, since the [mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/command-remover) doesn't distinguish between players.
- You may find my Minecraft username in some configuration files, since this modpack was initially developed for my personal use. I left these in for the convenience of using this modpack on my setups, but they shouldn't realistically affect your setups at all. However, feel free to remove the leftovers if you wish.
- Dedicated servers may include additional content under `/automodpack/host-modpack/main/` to be automatically downloaded and applied to clients. This functionality is offered by [AutoModpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/automodpack) and requires all clients to specify the fingerprint of the server on initial join. This fingerprint can be queried from the console with `/automodpack host fingerprint`.
- AutoModpack has been configured in a way that doesn't send the whole modpack to players, but instead only forces specific overrides to be applied to players. Importantly, if an override gets altered in any way, the client will restore the file to the default state defined on the server. This method is needed to achieve strong compliance, but it can have implications when used on frequently modified files.

</details>
